items.exampleEn: The teacher waited for the class to calm down.
I really want to get rid of this bad habit.
items.exampleZh: 我真的很想擺脫這個壞習慣。

items.exampleEn: It is not nice to break a promise.
I caught a cold during our camping trip.
items.exampleZh: 我在我們去露營的時候著涼感冒了。

items.exampleEn: My grandparents do exercise in the park every morning.
items.exampleZh: 我的爺爺奶奶每天早上在公園做運動。

items.exampleEn: My little brother always falls asleep quickly.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟總是很快就睡著。

items.exampleEn: She fell in love with the city on her first visit.
items.exampleZh: 她第一次去那座城市就愛上了它。

items.sentenceEn: Please calm down and tell me what happened.
items.sentenceZh: 請冷靜下來，告訴我發生了什麼事。

items.audioEn: My parents fell in love when they worked at the same bookstore.
items.audioZh: 我爸媽是在同一家書店工作時相愛的。
items.questionZh: 說話者的父母是在什麼情況下相愛的？
options: At the shop where both worked
In the same class in college

items.sentenceEn: Let's get rid of the clothes we never wear.
items.sentenceZh: 我們把從來不穿的衣服丟掉吧。

items.sentenceEn: We do exercise together in the school gym on Fridays.
items.sentenceZh: 我們每個星期五在學校體育館一起做運動。

items.stemEn: The movie was so boring that I ____ in the middle of it.
items.stemZh: 那部電影無聊到我看到一半就睡著了。

items.stemEn: My sister ____, so she couldn't come to the party.
items.stemZh: 我的姊妹著涼感冒了，所以沒辦法來參加派對。

items.passageEn: Last winter, Mia had a hard month. She caught a cold and stayed home for a week. Then her friend broke a promise to visit her. She felt sad and could not fall asleep at night. Her mother calmed her down and told her to go outside more. So Mia started to do exercise by the river after school. There she met a cute dog and its owner, Leo. Mia soon got rid of her bad mood, and later she fell in love with the dog!
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，Mia 過了很難熬的一個月。她著涼感冒，在家待了一個星期。接著她的朋友違背承諾，沒來看她。她很難過，晚上睡不著。媽媽讓她冷靜下來，叫她多出去走走。於是 Mia 開始放學後在河邊運動。她在那裡遇見一隻可愛的狗和牠的主人 Leo。Mia 很快就擺脫了壞心情，後來還愛上了那隻狗！

questions.questionZh: Mia 為什麼晚上睡不著？
媽媽叫 Mia 做什麼？

referenceEn: I have never broken a promise.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 never break a promise、have never broken a promise 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 always keep my promises 等）也算對
「從來不」可寫，例如 never break、have never broken 等

referenceEn: I fell asleep very late last night.
Last night I didn't fall asleep until very late.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 fell asleep 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 got to sleep、went to sleep 等）也算對
昨晚的事用過去式（例如 fell asleep late、didn't fall asleep until late、went to sleep late 等）
